key.zocular.zoom.desc: Hold (or tap, in toggle mode) to zoom in.
key.zocular.zoom_in.desc: Zooms in further while zoom is active. The scroll wheel does the same.
key.zocular.zoom_out.desc: Zooms back out while zoom is active.
key.zocular.cinematic.desc: Turns the cinematic camera on or off.
key.zocular.next_shot.desc: Cuts the cinematic camera to a new angle.
key.zocular.freecam.desc: Detaches the camera so you can fly it around.
key.zocular.freecam_panel.desc: Switches the freecam panel between its full and compact size while you're in freecam.
key.zocular.roll_left.desc: Tilts the horizon left in freecam and cinematic mode.
key.zocular.roll_right.desc: Tilts the horizon right in freecam and cinematic mode.
key.zocular.roll_reset.desc: Eases the camera roll back to level.
key.zocular.shoulder.desc: Cycles the third-person camera between center, right shoulder and left shoulder.
key.zocular.settings.desc: Opens this screen. You can also type /zocular in chat.
zocular.settings.title: Zocular Settings
zocular.settings.press_key: Press a key or mouse button to bind it. Esc clears the binding.
zocular.settings.hint: Hover over a setting to see what it does.
zocular.page.zoom.subtitle: Hold the zoom key and scroll to change how far you zoom.
zocular.page.cinematic.subtitle: A film-style camera that directs the scene while you play.
zocular.page.freecam.subtitle: Fly the camera anywhere while your character waits.
zocular.page.path.subtitle: Record keyframes in freecam, then play them as one shot.
zocular.page.camera.subtitle: Third-person distance, shoulder view and camera roll.
zocular.page.hud.subtitle: What Zocular shows on screen, and where.
zocular.page.controls.subtitle: Click a binding to change it. Red means a clash.
zocular.note.path.how_to: Open freecam, fly to where the shot should start and press Attack to drop a keyframe. Repeat for each point along the way, then press Use to play the path. Pick Block removes the last keyframe; Sneak + Pick Block clears them all.
zocular.note.camera.roll: Roll only applies in freecam and cinematic mode, and resets when you leave them.
zocular.note.hud.layout: In the editor, drag an element to move it and right-click it to put it back. You can also open it with /zocular hud.
zocular.note.controls.freecam: While freecam is on, Attack adds a camera path keyframe, Use plays or stops the path, Pick Block removes the last keyframe and the scroll wheel changes your flying speed.
zocular.option.zoom.enabled.desc: Turn this off if you use a different zoom mod and only want Zocular's cameras.
zocular.option.zoom.mode.desc: Hold: zoom while the key is held. Toggle: press once to zoom in, again to zoom out.
zocular.option.zoom.start_level.desc: How far each zoom starts before you scroll.
zocular.option.zoom.max_level.desc: The furthest you can scroll in.
zocular.option.zoom.scroll.desc: Scroll while zoomed to zoom further in or out. The hotbar doesn't scroll while you do.
zocular.option.zoom.remember_level.desc: Start the next zoom where you left the last one instead of at the starting zoom.
zocular.option.zoom.animation.desc: How long zooming in and out takes.
zocular.option.zoom.match_mouse_speed.de: Slows the mouse as you zoom so aiming feels the same at every level.
zocular.option.zoom.look_smoothing.desc: Smooths out mouse movement while zoomed, like a camera on a tripod head.
zocular.option.zoom.hide_hand.desc: Hides your hand and held item while zoomed.
zocular.option.cinematic.style.desc: Auto directs the scene for you, cutting between side, chase, front, roadside and wide shots. The other styles stick to one kind of shot.
zocular.option.cinematic.shot_length.des: Roughly how long Auto holds a shot before cutting to the next one.
zocular.option.cinematic.fov.desc: Field of view for cinematic shots. Lower values look like a longer film lens.
zocular.option.cinematic.distance.desc: How far from you the camera sits.
zocular.option.cinematic.height.desc: How high above your head the camera sits.
zocular.option.cinematic.orbit_speed.des: How quickly the orbit camera circles around you.
zocular.option.cinematic.follow_smoothin: Higher values make the camera trail behind you more loosely.
zocular.option.cinematic.reframe_angle.d: How far you can move from the middle of the frame before the tripod camera pans to follow.
zocular.option.cinematic.reframe.desc: Cut straight to the next shot like a film, or glide the camera over to it.
zocular.option.cinematic.transition.desc: How long the camera takes to fly out when the cinematic camera starts, and back when it stops.
zocular.option.cinematic.letterbox.desc: Height of the black bars at the top and bottom of the screen.
zocular.option.cinematic.vignette.desc: Darkens the corners of the screen for a filmic look.
zocular.option.cinematic.hide_hud.desc: Hides the HUD while the cinematic camera runs. It comes back when you leave.
zocular.option.cinematic.look_sensitivit: Mouse speed while the cinematic camera runs. Lower values make your movements look calmer on camera.
zocular.option.cinematic.shaders.desc: Switch Iris shaders on or off for cinematic shots. Your normal setting is restored afterwards.
zocular.option.freecam.speed.desc: Flying speed. You can also scroll while in freecam.
zocular.option.freecam.smoothing.desc: How gently the camera speeds up and slows down.
zocular.option.freecam.fly_where_looking: Move toward where the camera points, including up and down. When off, forward stays level like creative flight.
zocular.option.freecam.noclip.desc: Lets the camera fly through walls. Some servers don't allow this; check the rules first.
zocular.option.freecam.exit_when_hurt.de: Snaps the camera back to you as soon as you take damage.
zocular.option.freecam.show_name_tag.des: Shows your own name tag above your character while you're in freecam.
zocular.option.path.duration.desc: How long one run along the path takes.
zocular.option.path.constant_speed.desc: Moves at an even speed along the whole path. When off, each keyframe gets the same amount of time.
zocular.option.path.ease.desc: Starts and stops the path gently instead of at full speed.
zocular.option.path.loop.desc: Plays the path again from the start until you stop it.
zocular.option.path.hide_hud.desc: Hides the HUD for the length of the shot.
zocular.option.path.letterbox.desc: Adds the cinematic letterbox bars during playback.
zocular.option.third_person.distance.des: Scales how far the third-person camera sits from you.
zocular.option.third_person.shoulder.des: Moves the third-person camera over one shoulder. The Switch Shoulder key cycles this.
zocular.option.third_person.shoulder_off: How far to the side the shoulder view sits.
zocular.option.roll.speed.desc: How fast the Roll keys tilt the horizon.
zocular.option.roll.max.desc: The furthest the horizon can tilt either way.
zocular.option.hud.zoom_indicator.desc: Shows the current magnification under the crosshair while you zoom.
zocular.option.hud.freecam_panel.desc: Full shows your speed, keyframes and controls. Compact is a single line. The Freecam Panel Size key switches between them.
zocular.option.hud.path_timeline.desc: Shows a progress bar with the keyframes while a camera path plays and the HUD is visible.
zocular.hud_editor.title: Move HUD Elements
zocular.hud_editor.hint: Drag to move · Right-click to reset
zocular.action.hud_editor.desc: Drag the zoom level, freecam panel, status messages and path progress bar wherever you like.
zocular.notice.freecam_hurt: Freecam closed because you took damage
zocular.notice.path_too_short: Add at least two keyframes first
